name: Mohammad Ripan
headline: Engineering in progress.
intro: I build AI systems, workflow engines, and the infrastructure that makes them reliable. This is a living record of the things I'm building — and the details along the way.
about: I'm a software engineer working at the intersection of AI systems, distributed computing, and infrastructure engineering. My background spans backend architecture, distributed systems, and integration engineering. Today, I focus on production AI platforms, LLM applications, and the infrastructure behind them.
